notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB143) at the ARCHITECTURE the refuter asked for: keyed record images now live in ONE store per resolved host path (KeyedStoreTable, registry-owned - the same key PhysicalFileTable arbitrates sharing/locks by), attached by every relative/indexed connector over that path. The FIRST opener loads from disk; later openers attach to the LIVE store (never reload); every DELETE/WRITE/REWRITE is instantly visible to every attached connector ('the physical file', not a private snapshot); any CLOSE persists the one shared state, so the close ORDER can no longer resurrect a deleted record or drop another connector's write; the LAST detach drops the entry so a later OPEN re-reads the disk; OPEN OUTPUT empties the shared view; the IndexedStore shares the arrival mint so cross-connector writes keep ONE 14.9.30 GR26 retrieval order. Position/key state (FPI, key of reference, GR29a slot, GR38 high-key) stays per-connector. The store is UNCONDITIONAL - two SELECTs to one ASSIGN target reach it with no SHARING clause. pb143_shared_visibility runs the row's exact demanded trace: Q deletes, P reads '23', P writes, Q reads it back, then the CLOSE-order-reversed durability legs.
